title: Cooking for herself in New York
summary: She cooked steak, rice, greens and cornbread wherever she had a stove.

blocks.x: Well, when you were in New York, you were living in a room. Or was that an apartment? Did you cook for yourself in New York? When you were living in New York, did you used to cook for yourself or did you eat (inaudible)?

Well, yeah, I always cooked for myself, because I always (unintelligible) sometimes wouldn't have nothing but a broiled steak, you know, and sometimes I had some rice and pork chops and something like that. I always would get a room where I could use the stove. I like mustard greens and corn bread and I could cook me --
